title: RMIC Identity Contract
description: Schema for an RMIC-Guard identity contract, both unsealed (author-time) and sealed (contract_hash + anchor_embedding present) forms. This is the authoritative reference for core.validation.validate_contract_dict.

agent_id.description: Stable machine identifier for the agent this contract governs.

sector.description: Domain/sector this agent operates in, e.g. 'research', 'finance', 'healthcare'.

role_description.description: Optional free-text description of the role.

semantic_anchors.description: First-person sentences describing what the agent does. Embedded once at seal time into anchor_embedding; used at runtime to measure role_distance.

allowed_actions.description: Exact tool names this contract permits. Empty list means no allow-list restriction (only forbidden_actions applies).

forbidden_actions.description: Exact tool names that are always blocked, regardless of allowed_actions.

data_scope.description: Data categories the agent may/may not touch. 'prohibited' is enforced by the hard-rule pass.

parameter_constraints.description: Numeric bounds per tool-call argument name, e.g. {"amount": {"min": 0, "max": 5000, "type": "float"}}.

ids_warn_threshold.description: IDS score at/above which a WARN + re-anchoring recovery is triggered.

ids_block_threshold.description: IDS score at/above which the planned tool call is BLOCKed. Must be >= ids_warn_threshold.

drift_velocity_threshold.description: Step-to-step IDS delta above which a PREEMPTIVE_WARN is raised even while below ids_warn_threshold.

recovery_policy.description: Recovery strategy identifier consumed by core.recovery_engine.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this contract instance.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Set automatically at seal time if omitted.

contract_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest over every other field (sorted, canonical JSON). Present only once sealed.

anchor_embedding.description: L2-normalised mean embedding of semantic_anchors. Present only once sealed.
